Open a bash shell in a per-project sandbox

Usage: agent-vm shell [OPTIONS] [AGENT_ARGS]...

Arguments:
  [AGENT_ARGS]...  Args passed verbatim to the agent; use -- before any agent flags

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help (see more with '--help')

Sandbox resources:
      --memory <GIB>  Sandbox memory, in GiB [env: AGENT_VM_MEMORY_GIB] [default: 2]
      --cpus <N>      vCPU count for the sandbox [env: AGENT_VM_CPUS] [default: 2]

GitHub access:
      --no-git             Don't inject host gh/git credentials into the guest
      --repo <OWNER/REPO>  Add a repo to the GitHub allow-list (repeatable)

Mounts & ports:
      --mount <HOST[:GUEST][:ro|:rw|:follow-links]>
          Bind an extra host directory into the guest (repeatable)
  -p, --publish <[BIND:]HOST_PORT:GUEST_PORT>
          Publish a guest TCP port to the host, docker-style (repeatable)
      --auto-publish
          Auto-forward every guest listener onto the host (Lima-style)

Network egress:
      --allow-egress <IP|CIDR>  Allow guest egress to one IP or CIDR (repeatable)
      --allow-lan               Allow guest egress to the whole private LAN
      --allow-host              Allow the guest to reach the host's 127.0.0.1 services

Image:
      --image <REF>   Override the OCI image reference [env: AGENT_VM_IMAGE_TAG]
      --update-check  Check the registry for a newer image at launch (opt-in)
      --layer <DIR>   Tooling-layer directory (a Dockerfile built FROM the base image) [env:
                      AGENT_VM_LAYER]
  -y, --yes           Assume "yes" to the tooling-layer build confirmation prompt

Guest user:
      --root  Run the guest as root (uid 0) instead of the default host user

Examples (claude shown; codex/opencode/shell take the same options):
  agent-vm claude                  launch Claude Code in the current project
  agent-vm shell                   open a bash shell instead
  agent-vm claude -p 8080:3000     publish guest :3000 to host 127.0.0.1:8080
  agent-vm claude -- --model opus  forward args to the agent (after --)

Trailing args go to the agent. Run with --help for networking, security, and env details.
